name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to the distilled 32B variant now. It’s the only model that clears the latency ceiling Torque flagged while still beating the 8B-13B baseline on core tasks—no other option hits that sweet spot. The trade-off is higher compute cost per query, but we offset it with aggressive batching and caching to keep throughput tight.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t latency—it’s benchmark drift. A 32B distilled model’s 0.5% gain today may vanish tomorrow if the benchmark shifts. Settle it with a 100-hour bake-off comparing the 32B against a fine-tuned 8B on *EXCAVA’s live error logs*, not synthetic tasks.
